title: sos_origin: verify_sos_origin_gated doc claims fail-closed on capacity exhaustion (wrong)
description: 3x codereview on b7z9.121.4 (edge finding 3): rust/lichen-link/src/sos_origin.rs:214-216 doc says 'fail closed otherwise — including when the gate is capacity-exhausted'. For an UNKNOWN origin at capacity, accept evicts the least-recently-accepted entry and ACCEPTS (fail-open for new origins; the tracker test comment at :280 even says 'fail-open-ish'). Only fail-closed paths: bad signature / non-advancing seq / zero capacity with unknown origin. Reword the doc.
close_reason: Doc reworded: verify_sos_origin_gated now accurately states fail-closed paths (bad signature / non-advancing seq / unknown origin at zero capacity) vs new-origin-at-capacity eviction (fail-open for new origins, bounded gate). 13/13 tests pass. 3x codereview (correctness/security/edge, kimi-k3): correctness PASS, edge PASS; security found one residual doc hole — eviction discards replay state (older seqs acceptable again post-eviction) — filed as new P3 bead for a one-clause doc addition.
